$comment: Single source of truth for every value Helios may display. The contract is described in data-provenance.md; scripts/check-provenance.mjs validates this file, regenerates the register table in that document and fails the build if the two disagree.

metrics.label: Global horizontal irradiance
metrics.source: Open-Meteo forecast or ERA5 reanalysis; seeded synthetic generator when neither is available (NFR-11).
metrics.notes: Class X when a provider supplied the series, class S when the synthetic fallback did; the run manifest records which.

metrics.label: Direct normal irradiance
metrics.source: Open-Meteo forecast or ERA5 reanalysis; synthetic fallback as for MET-01.
metrics.notes: Used by the transposition step; shown in the weather detail panel.

metrics.label: Diffuse horizontal irradiance
metrics.source: Open-Meteo forecast or ERA5 reanalysis; synthetic fallback as for MET-01.
metrics.notes: Used by the transposition step; shown in the weather detail panel.

metrics.label: Ambient temperature
metrics.source: Open-Meteo forecast or ERA5 reanalysis; synthetic fallback as for MET-01.
metrics.notes: An air-temperature model output, not a reading from a site thermometer.

metrics.label: Wind speed at 10 m
metrics.source: Open-Meteo forecast or ERA5 reanalysis; synthetic fallback as for MET-01.
metrics.notes: Feeds the cell-temperature model.

metrics.label: Cloud cover
metrics.source: Open-Meteo forecast or ERA5 reanalysis; synthetic fallback as for MET-01.
metrics.notes: Shown with the weather source label; a forecast cloud fraction is not an observation.

metrics.label: Plane-of-array irradiance
metrics.source: Simplified transposition from GHI, DNI and DHI plus panel tilt and azimuth; an approximation labelled in code and report (FR-PV-03).
metrics.notes: The transposition model is named in the interface tooltip, not hidden.

metrics.label: Cell temperature
metrics.source: NOCT-type thermal model from ambient temperature, plane-of-array irradiance and wind speed.
metrics.notes: A modelled cell temperature, not a module sensor reading.

metrics.label: Sun elevation
metrics.source: Solar-position algorithm (SunCalc or a validated equivalent) evaluated at the simulation instant for the site coordinates.
metrics.notes: Checked against an independent ephemeris in FR-PV-02.

metrics.label: Sun azimuth
metrics.source: Solar-position algorithm evaluated at the simulation instant for the site coordinates.
metrics.notes: Drives the twin's sun direction; decorative lighting is labelled separately.

metrics.label: Daylight state
metrics.source: Derived from sun-elevation thresholds; drives day/night rendering and forces zero PV at night (FR-PV-06).
metrics.notes: One of night, twilight, day.

metrics.label: PV DC power
metrics.source: POA irradiance × installed DC capacity × temperature factor × (1 − soiling) × (1 − mismatch) × shading × availability.
metrics.notes: A modelled array output; never described as production data.

metrics.label: PV AC power
metrics.source: min(DC × inverter efficiency, rated AC power); zero at night and never negative (FR-PV-06).
metrics.notes: Clipping is visible in MET-24, not silently absorbed.

metrics.label: PV interval energy
metrics.source: AC power × interval length, integrated to the step boundary.
metrics.notes: The atom of the energy balance; every total is a sum of these intervals.

metrics.label: PV daily energy
metrics.source: Sum of PV interval energy over one site-day (midnight to midnight, site timezone).
metrics.notes: Displayed with the interval count and the day it covers.

metrics.label: Specific yield
metrics.source: PV daily energy ÷ installed DC capacity.
metrics.notes: Comparable across scenarios; carries the simulated label of MET-15.

metrics.label: Performance ratio
metrics.source: Actual yield ÷ reference yield (POA energy × installed capacity).
metrics.notes: A model-to-model ratio, not a measured performance ratio.

metrics.label: Soiling loss
metrics.source: Energy removed by the configured soiling fraction; one row of the loss breakdown (FR-PV-05).
metrics.notes: Individually attributable, not folded into a single efficiency number.

metrics.label: Shading loss
metrics.source: Loss from configured shading windows, applied at the timestep.
metrics.notes: A configured horizon approximation, not a ray-traced shadow.

metrics.label: Mismatch loss
metrics.source: Loss from the configured module-mismatch fraction.
metrics.notes: A lumped parameter, documented as an approximation.

metrics.label: Availability loss
metrics.source: Loss from the configured availability fraction (planned and unplanned downtime).
metrics.notes: Not a measured outage log.

metrics.label: Temperature derating loss
metrics.source: Difference between output at the stated cell temperature and output at 25 °C, using the configured temperature coefficient.
metrics.notes: Battery-inverter losses are reported separately, never merged.

metrics.label: Inverter conversion loss
metrics.source: DC energy minus AC energy plus configured standby consumption (FR-BAT-05).
metrics.notes: Standby is a configured constant, shown as such.

metrics.label: Clipping loss
metrics.source: DC energy that exceeds the inverter AC limit while clipping is enabled.
metrics.notes: Zero when clipping is disabled; never negative.

metrics.label: Tracker actuator energy
metrics.source: Energy consumed by tracker actuators, from the configured axis count and actuation profile (FR-PV-09).
metrics.notes: Shown only when tracking is enabled; subtracted in MET-26.

metrics.label: Tracking net gain
metrics.source: Additional harvest minus actuator energy, divided by fixed-tilt harvest.
metrics.notes: A net figure; the report must not quote the gross gain.

metrics.label: Battery power
metrics.source: Signed dispatch power, positive for discharge, applied to the energy-bucket battery model (DEC-007).
metrics.notes: The sign convention is stated in the axis label.

metrics.label: Battery state of charge
metrics.source: Previous SOC plus charge minus discharge with round-trip efficiency, clamped to the usable window (FR-BAT-02).
metrics.notes: Displayed with the configured minimum and maximum as reference lines.

metrics.label: Battery interval energy
metrics.source: Charge or discharge energy over the interval, after applying efficiency.
metrics.notes: Charge and discharge are separate sums even when drawn on one axis.

metrics.label: Battery throughput
metrics.source: Sum of absolute charge plus absolute discharge over the run.
metrics.notes: A wear proxy; explicitly not a remaining-useful-life estimate (FR-BAT-06).

metrics.label: Battery round-trip loss
metrics.source: Energy drawn from the battery minus energy delivered back, at the configured round-trip efficiency.
metrics.notes: A modelled efficiency loss, not a thermal measurement.

metrics.label: Battery capacity fade proxy
metrics.source: Optional linear capacity-fade proxy from the configured annual fade rate.
metrics.notes: Disabled by default; never presented as a remaining-useful-life prediction (FR-BAT-06).

metrics.label: Reserve SOC
metrics.source: Policy threshold read from the scenario (baseline or scheduler reserve).
metrics.notes: Drawn as a dashed reference line; never summed into results.

metrics.label: Minimum SOC
metrics.source: Usable-window lower bound read from the scenario.
metrics.notes: Part of the battery gauge's configured window.

metrics.label: Maximum SOC
metrics.source: Usable-window upper bound read from the scenario.
metrics.notes: Part of the battery gauge's configured window.

metrics.label: Inverter AC limit
metrics.source: Rated AC power read from the scenario.
metrics.notes: Drawn as a limit line on the AC power chart; a configured value, not a measurement.

metrics.label: Household load power
metrics.source: Sum of appliance contributions generated by the seeded load model; contributions sum exactly to the total (FR-LOD-04).
metrics.notes: Synthetic household behaviour, not metered consumption.

metrics.label: Household interval energy
metrics.source: Household load power × interval length.
metrics.notes: The demand side of the energy balance.

metrics.label: Appliance power
metrics.source: Rated power × run fraction for one appliance instance in one interval.
metrics.notes: Powers are declared in the scenario; run fractions come from the seeded model.

metrics.label: Appliance interval energy
metrics.source: Appliance power × interval length.
metrics.notes: Displayed per appliance and per room (MET-42).

metrics.label: Appliance state
metrics.source: State machine output for one appliance: off, scheduled, running, paused/deferred, completed or unavailable (FR-LOD-03).
metrics.notes: Illegal transitions are rejected by the engine, not hidden by the interface.

metrics.label: Room load
metrics.source: Sum of appliance instances assigned to one room.
metrics.notes: A display subtotal, labelled as derived.

metrics.label: Deferred energy
metrics.source: Flexible-load energy moved outside its original window by the scheduler.
metrics.notes: Shown with the affected appliances and the deadline that constrained the move.

metrics.label: Unmet critical demand
metrics.source: Required critical energy minus served critical energy.
metrics.notes: Reported, never dropped silently (FR-EMS-06).

metrics.label: Grid import power
metrics.source: Residual of the energy balance after local supply and dispatch; limited by the configured import limit.
metrics.notes: Zero during an outage; restoration is a logged event (FR-GRD-02).

metrics.label: Grid export power
metrics.source: Surplus after local use, battery charging and export limit are applied.
metrics.notes: Zero when export is disabled or the limit is zero.

metrics.label: Grid connection state
metrics.source: Connected, islanded or restored, from the configured outage windows.
metrics.notes: Outages are configured, not observed.

metrics.label: Grid import limit
metrics.source: Import limit read from the scenario.
metrics.notes: Zero in off-grid mode; drawn as a limit line.

metrics.label: Grid export limit
metrics.source: Export limit read from the scenario.
metrics.notes: Zero in off-grid mode; drawn as a limit line.

metrics.label: Energy balance residual
metrics.source: Absolute supply minus demand per step, including losses; tolerance 1 × 10⁻⁶ kWh (AC-01).
metrics.notes: A diagnostic, shown in the run detail rather than the overview.

metrics.label: Self-consumption ratio
metrics.source: Local PV energy used on site divided by total PV generation.
metrics.notes: Both numerator and denominator are labelled in the tooltip.

metrics.label: Self-sufficiency ratio
metrics.source: Locally supplied energy divided by total household demand.
metrics.notes: Reported with the interval range it covers.

metrics.label: Curtailed PV energy
metrics.source: Available PV energy that could not be stored, used on site or exported.
metrics.notes: Every curtailment decision carries a reason code (FR-EMS-07).

metrics.label: Critical-load uptime
metrics.source: Intervals with critical demand served divided by intervals with critical demand.
metrics.notes: The denominator is shown; a ratio without a denominator is not displayed.

metrics.label: Grid import cost
metrics.source: Imported energy × verified tariff band.
metrics.reason: Tariff values are unverified; economic metrics stay disabled until a dated STEG citation exists (FR-GRD-03, CON-08).
metrics.notes: The interface shows the gate and the reason, never an assumed price.

metrics.label: Export compensation
metrics.source: Exported energy × verified compensation rate.
metrics.reason: Compensation values are unverified; the metric stays disabled (FR-GRD-03).
metrics.notes: Disabled for the same reason as MET-55.

metrics.label: Net cost
metrics.source: Import cost minus export compensation plus the fixed monthly charge.
metrics.reason: Depends on two disabled metrics; it cannot be enabled before its inputs are (FR-GRD-03).
metrics.notes: The checker forbids an enabled metric with a disabled input.

metrics.label: Avoided CO₂
metrics.source: Avoided grid import × a dated, cited grid emission factor.
metrics.reason: No dated, cited emission factor has been selected; the metric stays disabled rather than using an assumed value.
metrics.notes: Enabling it requires a citation in the decision log, not an estimate.

metrics.label: PV power forecast
metrics.source: Weather forecast × PV model, issued before the simulated instant.
metrics.notes: Never plotted as an observed series; the legend states issue time and horizon.

metrics.label: PV energy forecast
metrics.source: PV power forecast × interval length.
metrics.notes: The forecast used by the scheduler; distinct from MET-14.

metrics.label: Load power forecast
metrics.source: Weather-driven or learned load forecast, issued before the simulated instant.
metrics.notes: A separate target from PV (FR-FCT-01); never mixed with MET-37 in one series.

metrics.label: PV forecast MAE
metrics.source: Mean absolute error of MET-59 against MET-13, per horizon, with sample count (FR-FCT-05).
metrics.notes: Never reported without the sample count.

metrics.label: Load forecast MAE
metrics.source: Mean absolute error of MET-61 against MET-37, per horizon, with sample count.
metrics.notes: Reported on time-aware splits only (FR-FCT-03).

metrics.label: PV forecast RMSE
metrics.source: Root mean square error of MET-59 against MET-13, per horizon, with sample count.
metrics.notes: Reported beside MAE, never instead of it.

metrics.label: Load forecast RMSE
metrics.source: Root mean square error of MET-61 against MET-37, per horizon, with sample count.
metrics.notes: Reported on time-aware splits only.

metrics.label: Forecast skill score
metrics.source: 1 − model MAE divided by the named naïve baseline MAE, per horizon.
metrics.notes: Positive means the model beats the baseline; a negative result is reported, not hidden.

metrics.label: Selected action
metrics.source: Action chosen by the active controller, with its trigger and active constraints (FR-EMS-08).
metrics.notes: Selecting the action opens its decision record.

metrics.label: Action reason code
metrics.source: Machine-readable reason for the chosen action (FR-EMS-07).
metrics.notes: Displayed as text, never as a colour alone.

metrics.label: Expected effect of action
metrics.source: The controller's own expectation for the action it selected.
metrics.notes: An inference stored with the decision, not a result; compared in MET-70.

metrics.label: Effect error
metrics.source: Realised interval effect minus the expectation stored with the action.
metrics.notes: Positive means the action delivered more than expected; the sign convention is stated.

metrics.label: Policy difference in grid import
metrics.source: Paired difference in grid import between the baseline and scheduler runs.
metrics.notes: Invalid if scenario, seed, weather, load trace or initial SOC differ (FR-EMS-09).

metrics.label: Oracle gap
metrics.source: Scheduler result as a percentage gap to the perfect-foresight oracle on the same scenario (FR-EMS-11).
metrics.notes: An upper-bound reference, not a deployable policy.

metrics.label: Anomaly score
metrics.source: Residual or model score computed from observed simulation state only (FR-SIM-08).
metrics.notes: Never presented as a probability and never computed from hidden world state.

metrics.label: Anomaly severity
metrics.source: Low, medium or high, with the expected range and evidence window attached (FR-ANM-03).
metrics.notes: Carries a false-positive caveat in the same panel.

metrics.label: Detection latency
metrics.source: Simulated time between an injected fault and the first detection, reported per fault type.
metrics.notes: Measured against injected, labelled faults only (FR-ANM-02).

metrics.label: Simulation clock time
metrics.source: Engine clock: scenario start plus elapsed fixed steps, displayed at the site timezone (DEC-003).
metrics.notes: The interface never reads the wall clock for a simulated value.

metrics.label: Step index
metrics.source: Number of fixed steps executed since run start.
metrics.notes: Shown in the run detail and exported in the manifest.

metrics.label: Simulation speed multiplier
metrics.source: Speed multiplier selected for the demonstration (1×, 60× or maximum), with fixed-step semantics unchanged (FR-SIM-09).
metrics.notes: A display and pacing control; it never changes computed values.

metrics.label: Run seed
metrics.source: Scenario seed that fixes the run.
metrics.notes: Displayed in the manifest and every export (NFR-03).

metrics.label: Installed DC capacity
metrics.source: Array capacity read from the scenario header (`pv.installed_dc_kwp`).
metrics.notes: Context for every yield figure; a configured value, not a measurement.

metrics.label: Panel count
metrics.source: Module count read from the scenario (`pv.panel_count`).
metrics.notes: Shown with the array geometry in the installation summary.

metrics.label: Array tilt
metrics.source: Tilt read from the scenario (`pv.tilt_deg`).
metrics.notes: Fixed-tilt is the default; tracking is optional (FR-PV-09).

metrics.label: Array azimuth
metrics.source: Azimuth read from the scenario (`pv.azimuth_deg`).
metrics.notes: 0° is north in the scenario convention; the interface states the convention.

metrics.label: Battery nominal capacity
metrics.source: Nominal capacity read from the scenario (`battery.nominal_capacity_kwh`).
metrics.notes: Distinct from the usable window, which is configured separately.

metrics.label: Battery maximum charge power
metrics.source: Charge limit read from the scenario (`battery.max_charge_kw`).
metrics.notes: Drawn as a limit line on the battery power chart.

metrics.label: Battery maximum discharge power
metrics.source: Discharge limit read from the scenario (`battery.max_discharge_kw`).
metrics.notes: Drawn as a limit line on the battery power chart.

metrics.label: Inverter efficiency
metrics.source: Conversion efficiency read from the scenario (`inverter.efficiency`).
metrics.notes: A single configured efficiency, not a part-load curve.

metrics.label: Inverter standby power
metrics.source: Standby consumption read from the scenario (`inverter.standby_w`).
metrics.notes: Included in MET-23; shown here as the configured source.

metrics.label: Node connection state
metrics.source: Inferred by the adapter from the last receipt time for the configured device: connected, stale or offline.
metrics.notes: Adapter health, not plant state.

metrics.label: Telemetry staleness
metrics.source: Adapter receipt time compared with the current simulation instant; computed locally, never received from the node.
metrics.notes: Negative or missing values are shown as unknown, never as zero.

metrics.label: Telemetry source mode
metrics.source: Manifest field `source_mode` of the active run: scenario, wokwi, physical or replay.
metrics.notes: Configured by the operator and recorded per run; never inferred from the data.

metrics.label: Telemetry sequence gaps
metrics.source: Adapter detects a discontinuity in the node's `sequence` counter and counts the missing positions.
metrics.notes: A gap is a delivery fact, not a measurement of the plant.

metrics.label: Bench node ambient temperature
metrics.source: DHT22 channel; simulated class S from the Wokwi node, measured class M from the physical bench node inside its declared validity range.
metrics.notes: Bench ambient conditions, not plant or cell temperature; cell temperature stays MET-15.

metrics.label: Bench node relative humidity
metrics.source: DHT22 channel; simulated class S from the Wokwi node, measured class M from the physical bench node inside its declared validity range.
metrics.notes: Not used by any engine calculation in v1.

metrics.label: Light-level proxy
metrics.source: Uncalibrated light-dependent resistor on an ADC1 pin; a relative level from 0 to full scale, simulated class S in Wokwi and measured class M on the bench.
metrics.notes: Never converted to W/m² irradiance; irradiance stays MET-01 and MET-02 from the configured weather source.

metrics.label: Firmware version
metrics.source: Version string compiled into the firmware and repeated in every telemetry document.
metrics.notes: Mismatch with the pinned version is shown as an alert, not silently accepted.

metrics.label: Telemetry schema version
metrics.source: `schema_version` field of the telemetry document, validated against the committed schema.
metrics.notes: An unknown version quarantines the message (FR-EMB-04).
